title: Scene v0: what a reconstruction path knows about one house exterior
description: The one output every reconstruction path writes and every criteria path reads. Contract: docs/scene-and-verdict-format.md. Lengths in meters (suffix _m). Frame: origin on the ground directly below the electric meter, +y up (against gravity), +z out of the meter's wall (horizontal), +x = y cross z, which is along the meter wall to the right as seen by someone outside facing it. Plan points are [x, z]. s is distance along the wall chain from the meter, positive to the right as seen from outside (so s = x on the meter wall). Unknown fields are rejected.

data.description: real: real images and real metadata. hybrid: real images with simulated metadata (for example simulated ARKit poses). synthetic: generated images or scenes.

site.description: House or dataset scene id, shared by every scene of the same site so scorers can pair them.

path.description: Track path id, e.g. A1-colmap, A2-mapanything, A5-worldlabs, gt-laser.

images_used.description: Images that actually contributed geometry (e.g. registered by SfM).

scale_source.description: Where metric scale came from. A scale_reference distance is excluded from key-distance scoring (it matches by construction).

scale_reference_ids.description: Key-distance ids used to set scale; the scorer skips them.

license.description: Licence of the model or service that produced the scene (commercial use matters).

element_id.description: The meter object whose ground foot is the origin and whose wall sets +z.

plus_minus_m.description: Position bound of the origin itself.

heading_plus_minus_deg.description: Bound on the meter wall's direction, which sets the x and z axes.

source_frame.description: The producer's own world frame, e.g. arkit_world, colmap_model, eth3d_world.

from_source.description: Similarity transform taking source-frame points into this scene frame (scale included). Column-major, like the packet's mat4.

path.description: Relative to the scene JSON file.

in_scene_frame.description: True when coordinates are already in this scene frame; otherwise apply frame.from_source.

fields.description: Per-element fields present, e.g. x, y, z, red, green, blue, n_views, conf, generated.

generated_field.description: Name of the per-element 0/1 field marking generated (hallucinated) geometry. Absent means the producer asserts none is generated.

role.description: house, garage and shed walls can back a battery (Profile C: a shed wall counts); fence and hedge are facing obstacles.

baseline_m.description: Ground line [x, z], left end first as seen from outside. Outward normal = direction turned 90 degrees clockwise seen from above.

base_y_m.description: Ground height at the baseline. Default 0.

polygon_m.description: Outline of the wall face in 3D (gables, steps). Default: the baseline swept from base_y_m up height_m.

s_range_m.description: Chain walls only: s at the left and right baseline ends.

plus_minus_m.description: Position bound of the wall plane and baseline.

observed_fraction.description: Share of the face from the ground to 2.13 m (7 ft) that coverage marks observed.

chain.description: The walls a battery could back onto, in order from the left end to the right end as seen from outside, starting from the meter's wall. Consecutive walls meet at a corner; a gap between them is a stretch with no wall.

turn_deg.description: Signed turn from the left wall's direction to the right wall's, seen from above; positive = outside corner (wall turns away from the viewer).

label.description: Free-text / open-vocabulary label as the detector said it.

size_m.description: [width along the box's local x, height, depth along local z].

yaw_deg.description: Rotation about +y from scene axes to the box's local axes. Default 0.

oneOf.description: A rectangle on a wall face: openings, wall-mounted equipment.

bottom_m.description: Height above ground of the lowest edge.

standoff_m.description: How far it stands out of the wall face.

wall_id.description: Wall the object is attached to or stands against, if any.

plus_minus_m.description: Position bound. Never derived from recognition confidence.

attrs.description: Recognised attributes. A missing attribute is unknown, never false.

movable.description: Plants, bins, a short fence section: sets requires_member_action instead of failing.

text.description: OCR text read from the object (meter number, label).

coverage.description: What the capture actually saw. Anything outside observed voxels / bands is unknown, and a check that depends on unknown space is UNSURE, never PASS.

method.description: How it was computed, e.g. rays_to_triangulated_points, depth_maps, lidar_depth, laser_visibility.

asset.description: Asset id of an npz with uint8 arrays `state` (0 unknown, 1 observed free, 2 observed occupied) and optional `views` (distinct views that saw the voxel, capped at 255), both shaped [nx, ny, nz].

origin_m.description: Scene coordinates of the grid's minimum corner.

min_views.description: Views needed before a voxel counts as observed. Default 1.

bands.description: Derived per-wall summary, compatible with PR #11 coverage.observed (in meters). wall: face from ground to 2.13 m; ground: strip out to out_m; overhead: space 0-0.91 m out from the wall, observed up to out_m high; facing: straight out to out_m (or to whatever faces the wall when absent).

overheads.description: Clear height under anything overhead along a chain wall (eaves, porch roofs, stairs, decks), measured within 0.91 m (3 ft) of the wall.

facing.description: Gap from a chain wall straight out to the nearest fence, hedge, wall or fixed obstacle, 0.3-1.83 m (1-6 ft) high.

lower_bound.description: True when nothing was found out to depth_m (the view reached that far): the real gap is at least this.

generated_regions.description: Space where the producer generated or completed geometry instead of observing it (world models, inpainting, hole filling, symmetry completion). Never evidence: a criteria path treats anything inside as unknown.

asset.description: For asset_mask: the asset whose generated_field marks the elements.

keyframes.description: Cameras in the scene frame (as the producer estimated them).

id.description: Packet keyframe id or image name.

pose.description: Camera-to-scene, ARKit camera axes (+x right, +y up, looks along -z), column-major.

intrinsics.description: [fx, fy, cx, cy], continuous pixels, (0,0) = top-left corner.

confidence.description: Recognition confidence. Never a distance error.

evidence.description: observed: seen in at least one real input image and supported by measured geometry. inferred: extrapolated from observations (a plane extended across an occluder, a corner closed by intersecting two walls, a wall run past the last seen point); a criteria path may use it to fail or to go unsure, never to pass. generated: produced by a generative model or hole filling; never evidence.

kind.description: limit: the wall really ends here for battery purposes (fence, property line, obstruction). unexplored: the wall continues but was not captured.
